title: PSRR at 1kHz and 100kHz, at 1mA and 50mA (small-signal AC around the DC operating point)
claim: Substantiates spec/target-spec.md's ratified "PSRR" row (>50dB @ 1kHz and >20dB @ 100kHz, at 1mA (light-load, binding) and at 50mA) against the LDO core-regulation-loop schematic (design/ldo_3v3in_1v8out.sch). The row is ratified by issue #1 / DR-006, and the four bounds below cite it verbatim. As of #117 this deck measures all FOUR conditions the row names -- both frequencies at BOTH load points. The v1 deck measured only the ~1mA point because the pre-#25 five-transistor amplifier had no valid regulating DC operating point at 50mA to linearize around; #25's current-mirror-OTA rebuild removed that ceiling, and the 50mA point now regulates (VOUT = 1.798V at tt/27C/3.30V), so the row's 50mA half is no longer un-testbenched. Both load points are swept inside one deck (the 1.8kOhm schematic load, then 'alter rload = 36'), the same single-deck/multi-point pattern sim/loop-gain uses.
statistical_convention: N/A (corner-matrix check, not a distribution claim)

analyses: * --- point 1: 1mA (the schematic's own 1.8kOhm load), the row's light-load point ---

measurements.name: psrr_1khz_1ma_db
measurements.note: PSRR at 1kHz, 1mA load (index 0 of the first 3-point 'ac lin 3 1e3 1e5' sweep -- ngspice's 'ac lin 2 ...' form drops a point on this deck, so a 3rd, unused midpoint is requested to work around it). Ratified bound: spec/target-spec.md "PSRR" row, >50dB @ 1kHz at 1mA.

measurements.name: psrr_100khz_1ma_db
measurements.note: PSRR at 100kHz, 1mA load (index 2, the first sweep's upper endpoint). Ratified bound: spec/target-spec.md "PSRR" row, >20dB @ 100kHz at 1mA.

measurements.name: psrr_1khz_50ma_db
measurements.note: PSRR at 1kHz, 50mA load (index 0 of the second sweep, after 'alter rload = 36'). Ratified bound: spec/target-spec.md "PSRR" row, >50dB @ 1kHz at 50mA.

measurements.name: psrr_100khz_50ma_db
measurements.note: PSRR at 100kHz, 50mA load (index 2 of the second sweep). Ratified bound: spec/target-spec.md "PSRR" row, >20dB @ 100kHz at 50mA. This is the condition #117 found the v1 one-load-point deck was not measuring at all -- it is the second failing sub-metric of the row, and it fails for a different reason than the 1kHz half (see design/README.md "#117").
